items.headline: LeBron Leads Sixers to NBA Cup Victory Over Reigning Champs
items.summary: LeBron James delivered a vintage performance, tallying 20 points, nine rebounds, and eight assists, as the Philadelphia 76ers edged the reigning NBA champion New York Knicks 98-93 in a thrilling NBA Cup Group Play opener. James made crucial plays in the final minutes to secure the win.

items.headline: Sixers Top Champs in NBA Cup Thriller
items.summary: LeBron James' clutch performance powered the Philadelphia 76ers to a 98-93 victory over the New York Knicks in their NBA Cup opener. Tyrese Maxey added 27 points for Philly.

items.headline: Mavericks Hand Rockets First Loss Behind Irving, Flagg Duo
items.summary: Kyrie Irving exploded for 35 points and Cooper Flagg added 33 points and nine rebounds, leading the Dallas Mavericks to a 116-111 comeback win over the Houston Rockets, who suffered their first loss of the season.

items.headline: Celtics Rout Bulls, Pritchard Shines Off Bench
items.summary: The Boston Celtics secured a dominant 125-111 victory over the Chicago Bulls. Payton Pritchard led the charge with a season-high 30 points off the bench, while Jayson Tatum chipped in 26 points.

items.headline: Magic Get Revenge on Raptors Despite Barnes' Career Night
items.summary: Desmond Bane's 28 points and Franz Wagner's 26 points and 11 assists propelled the Orlando Magic to a 121-114 win over the Toronto Raptors, spoiling a career-high 41-point effort from Scottie Barnes.

items.headline: Wizards Defeat Hornets Behind Davis' Double-Double
items.summary: Anthony Davis put up 25 points and 13 rebounds to lead the Washington Wizards past the Charlotte Hornets 95-79. Rookie AJ Dybantsa impressed with 17 points in his home debut.

items.headline: Curry's 31 Helps Warriors Erase Huge Deficit, Beat Lakers
items.summary: Stephen Curry sank eight 3-pointers en route to 31 points as the Golden State Warriors overcame a 25-point deficit to defeat the Los Angeles Lakers 112-95. Luka Doncic led the Lakers with 37 points.

items.headline: Hawks Hold Off Cavaliers in Close Contest
items.summary: Onyeka Okongwu delivered a season-high 29 points and 12 rebounds, complemented by Nickeil Alexander-Walker's 25 points, to lead the Atlanta Hawks to a 114-111 victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers.

items.headline: Pelicans Outscore Kings in High-Flying Affair
items.summary: Jeremiah Fears showcased his all-around game with 22 points, a career-high 13 assists, and eight rebounds, while Zion Williamson added 22 points on efficient shooting, as the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Sacramento Kings 132-120.

items.headline: Boozer's Triple-Double Leads Undefeated Grizzlies Past Blazers
items.summary: Cameron Boozer recorded his first career triple-double with 18 points, 12 rebounds, and 12 assists, helping the Memphis Grizzlies maintain their undefeated record with a 124-103 win over the Portland Trail Blazers. Deni Avdija led Portland with 24 points.

items.headline: Grizzlies Remain Only Undefeated Team, Pistons & Sixers Lead East
items.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies are off to a blistering 5-0 start, standing as the league's lone unbeaten team. In the Eastern Conference, the Detroit Pistons and Philadelphia 76ers share the top spot, both holding a 5-1 record.

items.headline: Key Injury Updates Across the League
items.summary: Portland's Ja Morant left last night's game with a hamstring injury. Oklahoma City's Cason Wallace has been sidelined with a torn labrum, requiring surgery. Houston's Alperen Şengün is listed as day-to-day with a back issue, while Utah's Lauri Markkanen is questionable with a wrist injury.

items.headline: Tonight's NBA Slate (Oct 31, 2026)
items.summary: A busy Saturday night is ahead with several intriguing matchups. The Portland Trail Blazers, featuring Deni Avdija, will visit the Utah Jazz (1:00 PM ET). Other notable games include the Charlotte Hornets at Washington Wizards (6:00 PM ET), New Orleans Pelicans at Orlando Magic (6:00 PM ET), and a Western Conference clash between the Houston Rockets and Oklahoma City Thunder (8:30 PM ET).
